project.objective: What children did Maria Dorothea Stockburger, wife of Johann Georg Meyer, have besides Magdalena (born 5 March 1817) and Anna Maria (born 9 November 1821)?

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: Explain findings clearly and simply, as if to someone new to genealogy research.

questions.question: What children did Maria Dorothea Stockburger, wife of Johann Georg Meyer, have besides Magdalena (born 5 March 1817) and Anna Maria (born 9 November 1821)?
questions.rationale: The tree records two children of Maria Dorothea Stockburger (I1) and Johann Georg Meyer (I2), Magdalena (I3) and Anna Maria (I4), both from the Sankt Georgen im Schwarzwald parish in Baden. The parish baptism registers would identify the rest of the couple's children.

items.jurisdiction: Sankt Georgen im Schwarzwald, Villingen, Baden, Germany
items.rationale: Enumerate all children of Johann Georg Meyer and Maria Dorothea Stockburger. The Sankt Georgen parish baptisms are name-searchable in FamilySearch collection 3015626 (Germany, Lutheran Baptisms, Marriages, and Burials, 1500-1971).
